# ClipSignal

> A Windows Codex suite for foreign trade content production and evidence-based buyer research. It connects editable Jianying drafts, company verification, WeChat Channels MCP, and authorized outreach.

Use the installation guide to load the project skill. Read the workflow capability and acceptance record before making claims about production readiness.
